claims.claim_en: THE UPPER WATERS ARE SUSPENDED BY THE WORD — R. Tanchuma's letter argument on the unit's own preposition diff: the text says ME-AL la-raqia ('from ABOVE the firmament'), not AL ('on') — so the upper waters do not REST on the built thing; they hang by the ma'amar. The suspension is a standing witness-grounded state with a later-text hook (Ps 148:4, 'the waters above the heavens' still praising). The GAP's geometry is a recorded dispute carried beside it (vast-as-earth-to-firmament BR 4:3/4:5 vs ben Zoma's three fingerbreadths, Chagigah 15a; ratio: exceed-by-thirty vs half-and-half; R. Yochanan's half-to-raqia half-to-ocean) — outcome converged: a standing separation, maintained by the word, whatever its measure.
claims.middah_note: letter-level derivation from the preposition (me-al vs al) — diqduq class, honestly unnumbered; the gap dispute carried open (I13/E15 shape, no deciding text)
claims.mechanics: WITNESS_STATE(mayim_elyonim, suspended_by_maamar) at STEP_Gn_1_7 after the partition — witness tier, walled, typed anchor Ps 148:4; geometry dispute recorded in the op text, never decided; ORAL_suspended_by_maamar upgraded from enrichment-only to claim-grade.

claims.claim_en: THE MISSING KI-TOV IS CHAIN-WITNESSED as a standing multi-position dispute — the chain asks the unit's central flag in its own words ('why is ki-tov not written on the second?'): (a) Gehinnom created that day; (b) MACHLOKET itself created that day — from our own clause 'vi-yhi mavdil bein mayim la-mayim' — and even order-building division earns no 'good'; (c) the water-work stood UNFINISHED — day 3 therefore carries ki-tov TWICE, once for the water's completion, once for its own work (the cross-unit accounting gen_03's double test already exhibits); plus Ben Zoma's astonishment at VA-YAAS ('they exist by the word!', Ps 33:6) and the flood-liability legion parable.
claims.middah_note: multi-answer machloket, carried open; position (b) is itself derived from our verse's own wording

claims.middah_note: notarikon — words read as compounds/acronyms — is E30 by the catalog
